Network traffic is something that is getting bigger 
every year because of the  Internet of Things, Cloud 
Computing and other factors. Legacy equipment are 
no longer reliable and secure, do you want to take the 
risk at the expense of time, money and safety?
Digital transformation is rapidly overtaking the 
Industrial network. Industrial devices are now being 
part of the IIoT, Industrial Internet of Things, which 
involves time-critical applications and demands high 
reliability. Through the use of TSN and PRP technology, 
these requirements can be accomplished.
Vector InfoTech who is specialized in Industrial 
Networking for more than two decades can provide 
the methodological and strategical network upgrades. 
We comprehensively study customer’s requirement, 
current network infrastructure, critical assets and new 
technologies to be deployed to plan and implement 
a smooth network upgrade with minimal downtime.
NETWORK DESIGN 
& SOLUTION
A good network is the key for a successful 
operation. A well designed network will 
optimize all your resources and will be the 
core foundation for future updates.
Vector InfoTech all over the years has been designing 
different industrial networks worldwide. We provide 
sophisticated network architecture and Cost-
effective solution based on best practice that is 
resilient, flexible and scalable within the organization, 
without compromising the performance.

All contents are subject to change without prior notice. Vector InfoTech assumes no responsibility for any errors which may appear in this document.WIRELESS NETWORK SOLUTIONS & SITE SURVEY
Wireless site surveys are essential to the success of 
any network project. Full understanding of the RF 
environment prior to installation ensures that your 
business network performs to specification.
On-Site or Predictive
The planning stages of any wireless network project are the key 
to its ultimate success. A comprehensive on-site survey is the best 
way to ensure the finalized network will perform as expected and 
any potential Radio Frequency (RF) pitfalls are avoided.
i. On-Site Survey
ii. Predictive Site SurveysVector InfoTech uses the smart and latest site survey 
tool to map out the RF area, measure sources of 
interference, identify any channel overlaps and 
confirm the optimum locations of access points and 
cable runs.
On-site surveys should be carried out where 
businesses are seeking to implement multimedia 
solutions over wireless, VOIP , high density Wi-Fi 
delivery (such as in schools or retail) or are operating 
in a potentially high RF interference environment. 
Ensuring the highest levels of accuracy, our 
engineers will take a predictive site survey plan and 
test provisional design onsite. By employing this 
methodology, we can be certain that the network 
design is able to deliver. The site survey document 
includes the survey heat maps, photographs of the 
site and hardware.A predictive site survey is a virtual survey of the site 
that uses the floor-plans and detailed drawings about 
the site to plan the wireless network.
The goal of a predictive site survey is to establish 
design criteria, such as AP quantity and placement 
with relative confidence. Doing so will then reduce 
the amount of effort required to perform the typically 
labor-intensive pre-deployment site survey.
Vector InfoTech’s RF engineers can create a digital 
model of the Wi-Fi environment using Software 
and also based on experience we can provide 
recommendations regarding the position and 
number of wireless access points to achieve the 
optimum degree of coverage.
Using the latest visual RF technology, this site survey 
will take into consideration the RF limitations of many 
different building materials, and other potentially 
troublesome objects, in order to build a picture of the 
raw throughput and transmit power levels.
